Execution flow follows standard Windows patterns: initialization via RoInitialize, registration of ETW (Event Tracing for Windows) providers for logging (Microsoft-Windows-Runtime-Networking-BackgroundTransfer), and activation of background tasks through a Factory pattern. No malicious behaviors or suspicious IOCs were identified.
